limitations: Only the default debug hart (mhartid=0) was captured. --core 1 fails with capability-unsupported in the current CLI, so the second core register state was not captured.
FPR f0..f31 were accessed with abstract register numbers 0x1020..0x103f. CLI csr:<number> passes through to abstract register access; these are not architectural CSR addresses.
RAM/peripheral/register reads are sequential snapshots with debug access effects; peripheral data reads may consume peripheral state.
Successful CSR/DMI reads do not prove implementation of every probed address.
RAM banks use the H417 reference-manual addresses; CLI warnings reflect its incomplete H417 RAM map.
Unconnected external memory and undocumented address space were not scanned.
Initial attach attempts returned no response. Later low/medium speed attach succeeded.
Flash programming, erase, loader, second-core selection, and functional communication tests were not performed.
